mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.system_boundary_level_of_abstraction: Mission and satellite system-of-interest for two 3U CubeSats, decomposed to subsystem requirements; executable behavioral detail is at ADCS simulation level, not EPS level.
mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.minimal_or_excluded_modeling: Student-collaboration requirements were not investigated in detail; testing architecture was not defined; only ADCS subsystem requirements are shown; EPS behavior and verification are not detailed.

RQ1: General nanosatellite mission modeling is shown through SysML stereotypes, requirement diagrams, trace/refine/derive/satisfy links, and model packages starting from customer needs and mission statements.
EPS is within the named low-level subsystem scope and EPS.# identifiers are described, but no EPS behavior, parametric model, or verification case is shown.

Limited early knowledge is handled through TBC statuses, iterative Phase-A/B refinement, and separating mission/system/subsystem requirement levels rather than through an EPS-specific minimal-behavior method.
RQ2: Reliability/quality, model reuse, traceability, and integrability benefits are claimed for MBSE/MDE and ADCS onboard-software development, not for EPS modeling.
Evidence for outcomes consists mainly of diagrams, workflow description, and one ADCS simulation check; no EPS-specific reliability, reproducibility, or integrability metric is reported.
RQ3: No EPS verification procedure is integrated into an EPS model in the paper.
The closest analogue is ADCS: a SysML parametric model calls MATLAB/Simulink, receives results, and automatically updates ADCS-F.34 requirement status before physical development.

direct_evidence_quotes.quote: This is basically a set of libraries which collect the MATLAB/Simulink models, including the spacecraft hardware (sensors/actuators), kinematics dynamics, the space environment, as well as some generic functions and algorithms.

With proper construction of Simulink models and wrap-up of engineering model and flight model of onboard software, this workspace even allows a seamless integration of requirement development, model verification, code automatic generation and verification with high efficiency and quality.
